  have hfin : Set.Finite (Set.range f) :=
    Set.Finite.subset
      ((Set.finite_Icc B T).prod ((Set.finite_Icc B T).prod ((Set.finite_Icc B T).prod (Set.finite_Icc B T))))
      (Set.range_subset_iff.mpr fun n => ⟨hB n, hB (n + 1), hB (n + 2), hB (n + 3)⟩)
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, h⟩ : ∃ i j : ℕ, i < j ∧ f i = f j := by
    by_contra! hc
    refine absurd (Set.infinite_range_of_injective fun a b hab => ?_) (Set.not_infinite.mpr hfin)
    rcases Nat.lt_trichotomy a b with hlt | heq | hgt
    · exact absurd hab (hc a b hlt)
    · exact heq
    · exact absurd hab.symm (hc b a hgt)
  simp only [f, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
  have hdet : ∀ p q : ℕ, 4 ≤ p → 4 ≤ q → u (p - 1) = u (q - 1) → u (p - 2) = u (q - 2) →

    intro p q hp hq a b c d
    have e := (hu q hq).1
    rw [← a, ← b, ← c, ← d] at e
    exact Int.cast_inj.1 ((hu p hp).1.trans e.symm)
  have H : ∀ m : ℕ, u (i + m) = u (j + m) := by
    intro m
